title: Chapter 178 Level 3 Village
content:
Chapter 178 Level 3 Village

"It is now possible to upgrade the silver village building order." Wang Shuo was delighted and quickly returned to the core of the territory to upgrade the village building order to the silver level.

But there was no reward, because there were too many silver village building order owners.

[Silver Village Building Order: The speed of territory construction increased by 2%, the speed of territory soldier training increased by 5%, and the growth cycle of territory crops was shortened by 2%. ]

Upgrading to the third-level village, the population has reached the level, and the only thing missing is a third-level energy converter.

Wang Shuo asked Duan Wenxi, the village does not have this thing now.

Wang Shuo thought that among his people, there must be people who came to seek refuge after their villages were destroyed, and they might have this thing.

So he asked in the [People Chat Group]: "Dear people, who of you has an energy converter? I will buy it at a high price."

Soon, someone responded that the other party wanted 2,000 gold coins, and Wang Shuo did not bargain and traded directly.

After synthesizing the third-level energy converter, the system prompted Wang Shuo that he could upgrade the third-level village.

[Do you want to upgrade Wana Village to a third-level village? 】

"Yes."

There was no system announcement either. It seemed that there were already quite a few level 3 villages.

Moreover, Wang Shuo did not wait long either. He thought that it might be because the current buildings were all built by himself, which took a lot of time.

So there was no need to wait for a few days to upgrade.

Compared with the level 2 villages, the scope of the territory of the level 3 villages was still expanded, and the other changes were not big.

At this moment, Wang Shuo noticed that there was a place on the map page that had a slight unusual change.

Wang Shuo hurried to the corresponding place.

There was an area of about 10 square meters on the edge of the central square, and the color of the land had obviously become a little abnormal.

But this change was very slow, and the grass on it looked a little withered and yellow. Wang Shuo observed for a while and remembered that this place should be the territory of Huang Feiguang.

There was also a copy buried below - the Dragon King Underground Palace.

At that time, because of insufficient strength, the passage was directly blocked.

Now it seems that something bad is going to happen.

The conflict between him and Zhao Tianze must be resolved.

Zhao Tianze raided Wana Village. It was impolite not to reciprocate. Wang Shuo wanted to attack the other side's village.

But if he went on the expedition, what if something happened in this place?

This place is located in the core area of his territory, and nothing can happen.

Wang Shuo squatted nearby and observed for a long time, but he still didn't make up his mind.

Let's observe for a night first!

He asked Baili Liang's city defense army to take out a team to surround this place and monitor it 24 hours a day to prevent other accidents.

At night, Wang Shuo continued to comprehend the "North Sea Empire Text Records". The progress was now 80%. Until he felt a little tired, Wang Shuo fell asleep.

The next morning, after Wang Shuo got up, he immediately came to the edge of the central square to check the situation above the Dragon King's underground palace.

"Did anything change last night?"

Wang Shuo asked the guarding soldier.

"My Lord, there is no special change, but the color of the land has deepened, as if it has been eroded by a cold breath."

Wang Shuo squatted down and looked, and the wild grass on it had died.

While eating breakfast, Wang Shuo looked worried.

"We can't wait any longer." He put down his chopsticks, swallowed the food in his mouth, and said to Ayub who was eating with him, "Prepare for war, we will go to flatten Fengze Village today."

"Yes, my Lord." Ayub immediately stood up, bowed straight, and saluted with a hint of excitement on his face.
